newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates move up, seen soft.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates move up, seen soft.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates climbed up on Monday on demand from borrowers after opening down and are likely to stay soft on Tuesday bnecause of surplus funds, dealers said.

Early deals were struck at 5.0 and 7.0 percent before the rates moved up to 14 percent later, one dealer said. "But the market closed with surplus funds as most banks maintained their cash reserve requirement of more than 5.0 percent."
On Tuesday, the rates are likely to remain low because of the surplus funds, he said. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
